phase1_assignment.objective: Find transversal generic mechanisms that let scheduled Chat agents reproduce several richer-mode outcomes at once without protected authority.
phase1_assignment.method: Audit existing methods before decomposition; compare multiple candidates by expected completion time, success probability, conflict/duplication risk and integration cost; test the best falsifiable candidate and preserve alternatives.
phase1_assignment.expected_output: A source-qualified transversal candidate or falsification, quantitative/ordinal comparison assumptions, exact scope, durable checkpoint and next Phase-1 alternative.
phase1_assignment.completion_reassignment: Checkpoint and select the next highest-value non-conflicting Phase-1 leaf in this role's CLEAN domain; never return to unrelated base work while Phase 1 is active.

non_regression.rule: Preserve config7 substantive cross-field role, CLEAN semantic isolation, exact tested-scope/provenance, existing-solution/direct/decomposition/transversal/alternative-plan method, checkpoint/resume, failure recovery, anti-stop, role-local write boundary, protected-primary boundary, and base restoration metadata. Config8 changes only the stale Phase-1 root binding from v3 to authoritative v4 and the per-invocation lifecycle wording needed to obey RUN_LIFECYCLE bounded recurring-open execution.

forbidden_semantic_inputs: commit messages/diffs/file snippets or unrelated semantic metadata exposed only while resolving transport authority
policy.feedback_use: Mechanical self-local quality control only; never infer novelty, relevance, acceptance, ranking, preferred mechanisms, O knowledge or other-worker information.
policy.own_state_resolution: LATEST/STATE first; otherwise newest source-qualified role-local checkpoint by repository chronology and minimum predecessor chain; quarantine accidental stale/cross-role observability reads.
policy.scope_guard: Never broaden positive or negative evidence beyond tested scope.
policy.continuation: Open-ended Phase-1 execution across recurring invocations; one result/checkpoint/no-change/blocker is never global completion. Under RUN_LIFECYCLE execute exactly one highest-value bounded semantic slice, persist and exact-read back a nonempty frontier and exact next action, then return recurring-open normally. Never intentionally continue until a hard runtime/tool termination, wait/poll/backoff/retry in-run, or start an optional second leaf.
policy.receipt_rule: Write immutable own receipt only; never read aggregate ledger or other receipts. Bind receipt to exact frozen root/config paths, blobs, parsed revisions, phase/root/task, bootstrap_valid, action/missing capability, conflict check and exact continuation.

control_freshness.preferred: Obtain SHA-only refs/heads/main; fetch exact-SHA DESIRED_STATE and this config; require a second SHA-only read before semantic work.
control_freshness.chat_fallback: When SHA-only ref lookup is unavailable, fetch the two approved authoritative paths and record exact returned blob SHAs/revisions, immediately fetch both again before semantic work, require exact equality and matching cross-control references, then freeze the stable tuple with transport_mode=exact_blob_two_pass.
control_freshness.fallback_failure: Diagnostic checkpoint only; keep recurring task enabled and retry next invocation. Unavailable SHA-only lookup by itself is not a reason to self-disable.
control_freshness.post_freeze: Unrelated main movement is not a stop if the frozen authoritative blobs are unchanged and no own-state conflict exists; do not consume newer-head semantic content.

policy.recurring_scheduler_persistence: While enabled_desired=true, this role must never call, request or imply platform automation disable/delete/pause because an invocation ended, checkpointed, found no new result, hit a runtime boundary, lacked a SHA-only ref lookup, or was classified fully blocked. Persist global_completion=false, exact blocker and continuation. Only the authorized controller may perform re-enable-only reconciliation after repairing a concrete cause.
policy.connector_discovery_read_only: Capability discovery is non-mutating. Mutations are allowed only when required by substantive role work and confined to authorized role-local state/output or immutable own receipt destinations with CAS/readback.
policy.primary_boundary: Never acquire or mutate primary O lease/fence/frozen request/protected state; never direct-merge main; never claim Work-only capability.

migration.reason: Current cross_field config7 still bound its active Phase-1 assignment to root v3 while authoritative O_CHAT control10 and DESIRED_STATE control26 use root v4, and its continuation still instructed run-until-hard-runtime behavior. Config8 aligns only those control/lifecycle fields so the existing CLEAN transversal role can produce bootstrap-valid bounded recurring-open Phase-1 evidence under RUN_LIFECYCLE.
migration.rollback_condition: Only independently proven authority, CLEAN-isolation, tested-scope/provenance, continuation/recovery or useful-output regression caused by config8. Repair by incrementing again; never restore the stale v3 root, deliberate hard-runtime execution, self-disable, protected-primary access, or unrelated base work as active Phase-1 work.
